name: Dunemaul Compound
summary: At the western edge of Tanaris, Dunemaul ogres gather around their central settlement. The clan’s mound and cave network lie among rocky ridges.

sections.title: A Stronghold in the Sands
sections.body: In western Tanaris, Dunemaul ogres guard their stronghold from travelers crossing the dunes. The harsh arid climate has taught the clan to survive through brute force and opportunism. Their settlement gathers around an ogre mound and a network of caves. Warriors and enforcers patrol beside twisted spellcasters who wield dark warlock and mage magic. The ogres violently reject uninvited guests.

faq.answer: Gor'marok the Ravager leads the Dunemaul ogres at the compound. In Gadgetzan, Andi Lynn fears the strength of this newly arrived band.

faq.q: What kinds of ogres live here?
faq.answer: Common brutes and enforcers live here, along with cunning ogre mages and warlocks who wield dark fel and shadow magic.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this compound?
faq.answer: The Horde has no recorded interest in the compound. Gor'marok the Ravager leads the independent Dunemaul band. In Gadgetzan, Andi Lynn calls for the compound's destruction because she fears their growing strength will threaten the region.
Omgorn the Lost is an elusive, solitary ogre who sometimes wanders the edges of the Dunemaul Compound. He stays apart from the common sentries patrolling the mound.

angles.text: Many ogres once marched with the Old Horde, but the reclusive Dunemaul answer to no outside power. They treat Horde travelers as intruders like any other.

As a warlock, you may find the Dunemaul warlocks a curious sight among a seemingly primitive desert clan. Their presence shows that shadow and fel traditions have taken root even in isolated ogre mounds.
